Gemini Notebook rebrand (#2013, shipped in #2020): notebook.google.com and .notebook.google.com joined the required cookie-domain tier because Google sets the per-product binding cookies (OSID / __Secure-OSID) on that host. Additive for the constant's documented use (an extractor allowlist); a narrower set would drop binding cookies and break login.
